subject: Order form handback — party sheet, template clarifications, and first redline asks
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@paynet.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: PayNet Legal <legal@paynet.io>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PayNet order form + party sheet — sending initial packet

Hi Olga / Kim,

Thanks again for the sync last week. Attached is PayNet's baseline order form (v1) and an Excel with our party details and billing contacts. We're hoping to get a short redline pass from Redwood so we can align on a mutual action plan — main asks below: 

- Confirm whether Redwood's standard MSA template or a counterparty MSA is expected here (PayNet preference is to adopt Redwood template).
- Clarify data residency language and logging retention options; PayNet is subject to a regional audit in Q4.
- Highlight any non-negotiable commercial terms (termination, indemnity caps, export controls).

Attachments:
- PayNet_OrderForm_v1.docx (order form, includes exhibit placeholders)
- ExhibitA_Parties.xlsx (party list + signer matrix)

Happy to schedule a 30-min follow-up if it helps.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement, PayNet
--Attachment: PayNet_OrderForm_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
--Attachment: ExhibitA_Parties.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@paynet.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 12:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PayNet order form + party sheet — sending initial packet

Elena — thanks for sending. Kim and I reviewed briefly; looping Marissa from Legal intake so we can start a tidy intake and redline plan. Quick notes from our side to set expectations: 

- Redwood typically prefers to start from our standard MSA. If PayNet wants to propose its MSA we'll still review, but expect a longer redline cycle. Please confirm preference.
- Data residency/audio logging: we can offer regional residency in our EU/US private instances depending on the plan (Dedicated/Private). We'll need to know the expected request volumes and retention period to advise on SLA/residency options.
- Commercial caps & indemnities: Kim will flag any commercial terms that deviate from our standard and propose fallbacks.

Marissa — can you confirm the earliest slot for an initial redline pass? Also attaching a short intake checklist with the fields we've asked for historically to speed the process.

Next steps proposed:
1) PayNet confirms template choice (Redwood MSA vs PayNet MSA) by EOD Tues 7/1.
2) Redwood does a 1st-pass redline (legal + commercial callouts) within 3 business days after confirmation.
3) Schedule 30-45 min sync post-redline to walk key items.

Thanks — Olga
Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
--Attachment: redwood_intake_checklist_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@paynet.io>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PayNet order form + party sheet — sending initial packet

Quick note — I scanned the order form and flagged three immediate items I expect to redline: 

1) Exhibit A lists multiple affiliates; we need a clarified signer matrix and whether invoices can be sent to a central finance email.
2) The 'service credits' SLA table uses per-month uptime thresholds that don't map to our Dedicated offering — will need to swap to our standard SLA language or propose a hybrid.
3) Data retention clause currently says "90 days" of logs; for enterprise customers we typically offer configurable retention (30/90/365) tied to pricing tiers — I'll propose alternative language and a short note on cost impact.

I'll prepare a tracked redline (first-pass) and share to the thread by EOD today. If anyone sees additional negotiation priorities (export controls, cryptography export language), flag here.

-Kim
Senior Counsel, Contracts
--Attachment: redlines_kim_20250630.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@paynet.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: PayNet Legal <legal@paynet.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PayNet order form + party sheet — sending initial packet

Thanks all — confirmed: PayNet is happy to start from Redwood's MSA. We've updated the party sheet (attached) to clarify the billing contact and central invoice routing. Also attaching an updated order form that removes a vendor-only residency clause. 

We appreciate the quick turnaround — please send your tracked redlines and a note on any pricing delta for longer log retention options. We are aiming for an internal procurement decision by 7/14, so a short redline + a 30-minute sync early next week would be ideal.

Attachments: 
- PayNet_OrderForm_v1.1.docx
- ExhibitA_Parties_v2.xlsx

Best,
Elena
Head of Procurement, PayNet
